name: What should I prepare before starting a whole-home renovation?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before starting a whole-home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting a whole-home renovation, it's beneficial to have a clear understanding of your desired outcomes, a preliminary budget, and an idea of your preferred styles and materials. Gathering inspiration, creating a list of 'must-haves' versus 'nice-to-haves,' and understanding your current home's limitations will help streamline the design process. Being prepared with these details allows for more efficient consultations with your contractor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before starting, prepare your desired outcomes, preliminary budget, preferred styles, and a list of 'must-haves' to streamline the renovation process.
